funds.holdingsNote: Holds about 2,000 small-cap U.S. companies that make up the Russell 2000 Index.

funds.name: Cal-Maine Foods
funds.blurb: Q1 FY27 net sales (reported Sept 30) plunged 41.5% to $539.6M as an industry egg glut drove conventional egg prices down ~59%, flipping CALM to a $58.6M net loss; the stock sits near $67.48 awaiting Q2 FY27 results due January 2027.

funds.name: Chemed Corp
funds.blurb: Q2 2026 revenue rose 8.8% YoY to $673.3M as VITAS hospice revenue grew 11.9% on higher patient census and a lower Medicare Cap hit, prompting Chemed to raise full-year guidance; shares now trade near $539.82.

funds.name: Saia Inc
funds.blurb: Q2 2026 revenue grew 17.1% YoY to a record $956.5M as Saia's LTL terminal network expansion kept driving tonnage and share gains, though shares have pulled back to $344.38 from their 52-week high amid cost pressures.

funds.name: Wingstop
funds.blurb: Domestic same-store sales fell 7.5% in Q2 2026 as low-income-consumer pullback persisted, prompting Wingstop to cut full-year same-store sales guidance to -4% to -6%; shares now trade near $104.36, well below their 52-week high of $388.14.

funds.name: Hanmi Financial
funds.blurb: Shares sit near $31.60 after Q2 net income climbed to $23.5M ($0.79 EPS) on net interest income of $63.9M, up 1.0% sequentially on an improved funding mix; a ~$930M market cap still leaves it far more news-sensitive than a diversified bank ETF.

funds.name: UMH Properties
funds.blurb: Manufactured-housing REIT with a $1.32B market cap; small enough that a single piece of unexpected news can move the stock far more than a diversified REIT fund would.

funds.name: CEVA Inc
funds.blurb: Shares near $34.46, up roughly 19% from the prior update; this semiconductor-IP licensor's small size (~$960M market cap) means a single contract win or chip-industry headline can still swing the stock sharply in a session.

funds.name: Ring Energy
funds.blurb: Permian Basin oil producer still trading near $1.18 with a $320M market cap; a sub-$2 share price keeps it one of the most volatile names on this entire watchlist.
